data.description:
## Description

**What**: Author a representative bad-copy fixture (jargon-laden questions, blame-language errors, vague hints) and an automated validation harness that measures baseline metrics, runs gov-copy-writer, re-measures the artifact, and asserts the before/after acceptance bar.
**Why**: sc-8 requires closing-session validation with measurable improvement; without it, the epic ships with per-component tests only and no end-to-end evidence.
**Scope**:
- IN: bad-copy fixture in the repo; harness that measures before/after fk_grade / active_voice / banned_words via the post-processor; PASS/FAIL assertion on the acceptance bar (fk_grade decreases ≥ 1, active_voice increases ≥ 20 percentage points, banned_words drops to 0); idempotent re-run; closure-check wiring
- OUT: gov-copy-writer agent (separate story); post-processor (separate story); canon corpus (separate story)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, a bad-copy fixture lives in the repo and is documented as the dogfood baseline
  ← Satisfies: sc-8 (sc-8: "Synthetic dogfood closing-session validation runs gov-copy-writer against a representative bad-copy example")
- When this story is complete, running the validation harness against the fixture produces measured before/after fk_grade, active_voice rate, and banned_words_found counts
  ← Satisfies: sc-8
- When this story is complete, the harness reports PASS only when average fk_grade decreases by ≥ 1 grade level, active_voice rate increases by ≥ 20 percentage points, and banned_words_found count drops to 0
  ← Satisfies: sc-8
- When this story is complete, the harness re-runs idempotently and is wired into the epic's closure checks
  ← Satisfies: sc-8
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations
- [Determinism] Baseline measurements are recomputed each run rather than pinned, so canon/threshold changes invalidate stale baselines.
- [Closing-session scope] This story is gated until the schemas, canon, agent, and post-processor stories land; treat it as the epic's closure check.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an epic-closing reviewer, the synthetic dogfood validation proves gov-copy-writer measurably improves known-bad copy
